invariants: parameter_schema and default_parameters are JSON objects
new models default default_tenant_enabled to false
an active model requires an active provider
provider_code is globally unique and model_code is unique within a provider
at most one catalog version is current
a catalog version is sealed in one transaction with at least one snapshot item
sealed catalog version items cannot be inserted, updated, or deleted
published catalog version metadata cannot be changed except is_current
published models cannot be hard deleted
tenant model policy is scoped by tenant_id
lingframe_app has no DDL or hard-delete privileges
